label: Chronic stress primes TLR3-mediated systemic inflammation to produce persistent post-viral fatigue syndrome-like symptoms in mice.
summary: This study examined the long-term effects of polyinosinic:polycytidylic acid (poly I:C), a synthetic double-stranded RNA and Toll-like receptor 3 (TLR3) agonist, on behavioral and immune outcomes in chronically stressed mice. Male C57BL/6J mice were exposed to 21 days of wet bedding stress followed by a poly I:C injection.
